newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia soldier on trial for Irian Jaya shooting.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia soldier on trial for Irian Jaya shooting.

text.p: A soldier in Indonesia's elite special forces was on trial in remote Irian Jaya province on charges of killing 16 people in a one-man shooting spree last year, a court official and a military spokesman said on Monday.
"The trial opened on April 10 and is still going on," a military court official told Reuters from Jayapura, the capital of Irian Jaya.
The official said Second Lieutenant Sumorip of the Kopassus, or special forces, was accused of shooting the 16 at the airport in Timika town last April, apparently over a personal grudge.
He said the victims included Sumorip's commanding officer and three fellow Kopassus soldiers, but declined to elaborate.
Other soldiers and four civilians, including a New Zealand pilot working in Irian Jaya, were also killed in the two-hour shooting spree, newspapers said then. Ten people were injured.
Military prosecutors believed the defendant was frustrated with some of the assignments he had been given, the military spokesman said.
Sources in the area told Reuters last year the lieutenant had been aboard an aircraft that made a refuelling stop at Timika airport, escorting the bodies of two soldiers hacked to death by tribesmen.
